resolution: Removed the dead duplicate build pane entirely. The editor had two iso build surfaces — LoaderIsoView (the live native loader pane the user builds in) and IsoAuthor (an older React-drawn twin), switched by a loader/react toggle — and each carried its OWN copy of the drag-paint placement gate, so a fix in one silently failed to reach the other (the whole req_1944→1964 saga). Deleted IsoAuthor.tsx, its loader/react toggle, and the loaderView state; LoaderIsoView is now the single build pane (auto-compile toggle kept, un-gated). Bundle compiles and shrank; no remaining ./IsoAuthor imports. Done together with req_1967 (the extraction). SHA f76513e8a.
